meta.name: learning-harvest
meta.description: Manage the operational learnings lifecycle — load prior learnings to inform current work, harvest new patterns worth preserving, and keep the document tight over time. Provides a protocol for accumulating actionable patterns from practice that complement standards and defaults. Use when a workflow session completes and produced insights worth persisting, when starting a session that should benefit from prior patterns, or when the user says 'harvest learnings', 'what have we learned', 'capture this pattern', 'tighten learnings', or 'operational learnings'.

copy.tagline: 积累并复用工作中学到的经验模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把每次工作的心得变成可复用的行动指南
copy.tagline_en: Capture and reuse patterns learned from practice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn insights from each work session into reusable action guides
